title: Kabbe condensation: a comprehensive review of spirochromanone synthesis and medicinal applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13183-13222
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09951J, Review Article

Rashinikumar Samandram, Boopathi Komarasamy, Prasanth Murugan, Prabhakaran Jayaraj, Manohar Vemparala, Abdul Fareed Chaman, Parthiban Anaikutti
The Kabbe reaction is a condensation reaction that mainly involves an enamine and 2-hydroxy acetophenone to construct a spiro-chromanones skeleton. The numerous synthetic methods and advances in the Kabbe process are discussed in this review.
